title: Card Blur Gradient
description: 卡片底部用 backdrop-filter 加 mask 漸層，做出從清楚到模糊的過渡；滑鼠移上去模糊帶會升高。類似 Apple 2025 的卡片風格。
descriptionEn: backdrop-filter plus a mask gradient at the bottom of a card, fading from sharp to blurred; the blur band rises on hover. Similar to Apple's 2025 card style.
author: Antonio
